meta.name: sleek-design-mobile-apps
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design a mobile app or UI screens, when they mention their Sleek (sleek.design) projects, or when implementing Sleek designs in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把移动应用界面设计成可直接落地的多端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做移动应用界面设计，并想用 Sleek 设计系统快速实现
copy.tagline_en: Turn mobile app designs into implementable code across platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you design mobile UIs and want to implement them with the Sleek design system.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 Sleek API 帮你做手机 App 的界面设计:先建项目,把你的自然语言描述发给 Sleek 生成界面,再把截图拿给你看;要写代码时,它会取回组件 HTML 作为实现依据。
howto.when: 当你想设计手机 App 或 UI 界面、提到自己的 Sleek 项目,或要求把 Sleek 设计用代码实现(HTML、React Native、SwiftUI 等)时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个记账 App 的界面,风格干净。
say.note: 会新建 Sleek 项目并发起设计,完成后把截图发给你。

say.text: 用这个项目的当前版本生成 React Native 代码。
say.note: 会读取当前组件的 HTML 和截图来生成代码。

say.text: 给这套界面出一个深色变体,单独建项目。
say.note: 会为新变体单独建项目并完成设计。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses Sleek's API to design mobile app UI: it creates projects, sends plain-language design briefs, shows screenshots, and fetches component HTML when implementing in code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to design a mobile app or UI screens, mentions their Sleek projects, or wants Sleek designs implemented in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI, etc.).

say_en.text: Design a clean home screen for a budgeting app.
say_en.note: Creates a Sleek project, runs the design, then screenshots it for you.

say_en.text: Generate React Native code from this project's current version.
say_en.note: Fetches the active component HTML and screenshots, then implements it.

say_en.text: Make a dark-style variation of this UI in a separate project.
say_en.note: Creates a new project for the variation and designs it independently.
